body.objective: Compute the first genuinely higher Kuranishi operation for the compact-Cauchy Weyl-Maxwell constraint algebroid and decide whether a second-order charge-balanced Einstein/extra tangent remains integrable at third order.
body.stop_condition: Import the terminal mixed-charge derived-correspondence result, the two-jet constraint-algebroid carrier and the exact finite-harmonic quadratic source by hashes. Derive the cubic Kuranishi obstruction on a declared Sobolev or finite-harmonic slice, including the contribution from a chosen second-order correction, and prove its change under correction/gauge representatives is exact or identify the residual ambiguity. Evaluate it first on the certified balanced Einstein-minus/extra fixture and then on the smallest complete resonance-closed carrier containing that fixture. Determine whether the five quadratic Taub charges remain sufficient through third order, whether a new adjoint-shell or stabilizer covector appears, or whether the cubic operation is not yet defined because a precise D3 constraint/action input is missing. Export exact tensors or a content-addressed missing-input certificate, method-distinct verification, correction-choice mutations and a scope-typed Paper 13/atlas disposition.
body.current_gate: third-order integrability of the mixed-charge derived tangent cone
body.forbid: no quadratic moment-map cancellation called all-order integration; no arbitrary second-order correction hidden in the result; no retained representative called a cohomology operation without independence proof; no fixed-group AMM assumption; no bounded stability, causal spacetime, particle or quantum promotion
activates: or the exact next nonlinear constraint input request
body.resource_hint: OUTCOME-SAFE BRIDGE SUCCESSOR. Begin with one balanced fixture and a human-verifiable Kuranishi formula; if D3 data are absent, export the exact missing multilinear map rather than reconstructing a competing action.
